lore.speaker: Oskar
text: You're new. You've got that look. Like you walked into a room and forgot why.
North of the forest is the Archive. The Archivist keeps records of everything forgotten.
Folks say once something's filed... it's erased. Gone from the Hollow, even.
Me, I keep a list of things I want to remember. Item one: don't go north.

fear.speaker: Oskar
text: The Lostlings have been whispering. Said someone's been erasing them.
I'd ask you not to erase me, but I suppose asking hasn't stopped you.
